tool: python -m touhou_rl.v410.dagger.train train (WP05.3 CLI, read-only use)
purpose: retrain the WP05.3 B0 student under the identical fixed budget on all 15 complete DAgger shards (52,500 decisions >= 50k) and run the 20 dev episodes on the same S1N ruler; a controlled descriptive comparison with the 21k WP05.3 checkpoint, not G410-2

shard_selection.note: the 15 shards above were the complete batch when the conversion was enumerated (52,500 decisions >= 50,000). Shard dagger-s0d1seed2024 of batch B finished at 2026-11-13T08:53:54+08:00, after the labels and the seed list were fixed, so it is not part of this run; it would add 3,500 decisions (56,000 total) and is recorded here for transparency only

data.note: per-shard label diagnostics are kept in .tmp_v410_wp05_train50k/train_run.json

mix.rule: per-step cumulative allocation floor((step+1)*steps*batch*share) - floor(step*steps*batch*share) S1 rows; per-sample loss weight 1.0; the batch order is shuffled per step, so the mix is the only source signal

metrics.confusion_matrix_orientation: rows = target action, columns = predicted action

label_rule.note: chosen one-hot CE only; the other 17 logits appear solely in the softmax denominator

gpu.peak_memory_note: torch.cuda.max_memory_{allocated,reserved} over this run; reset immediately before the first step

commands.step: convert 15 shards with the WP05.2 CLI

window_alignment.training_window: the D410-S1 shards store frames[t-3..t], four consecutive game frames; one decision = two frames = two renders, so the stack is consecutive

dev_eval.note: 20 dev episodes on the real rl_v3 engine; clear_rate is not a pass rate and no interval is attached

checkpoint.role: BC baseline (behaviour cloning), not an RL-trained policy

comparison_21k.design: same command, same budget (1,000 steps x batch 128, seed 0, S1 20 %/DAgger 80 %, AdamW 3e-4/wd 1e-4/clip 5.0), same S1 train split (seeds 1-14), same dev suite and the same 20 dev seeds; the only factor that changed is the DAgger corpus (6 shards/21,000 -> 15 shards/52,500 decisions)

paired_summary.note: descriptive paired frame-count differences on the same 20 dev seeds; no interval, no hypothesis test, no gate

comparison_21k.note: descriptive only: one checkpoint per corpus, one training seed, one budget; the offline metrics are in-sample and the corpora were drawn from different collection batches (batch B added seeds 2020-2023)

scope.purpose: WP05.5 50k first-round retrain (same budget as WP05.3) + 20 dev episodes

not_claimed: not G410-2: no confirm split (60000-60199 never read), no four-arm matrix, no pre-registered pass/fail rule, no gate
no new DAgger data was collected for this work package: the 15 shards are the existing WP05.1 completion batch (β=1.0, teacher fully injected)
no β=0.5 round and no multi-round DAgger loop was run
the offline metrics are in-sample metrics on the 128,000 training batches this run consumed, not held-out accuracy
the 50k-vs-21k difference is descriptive only: one training seed, one budget, two corpora from different collection batches, no interval and no test
no significance test, no confidence interval, no ranking and no effect estimate
the 20 dev episodes are a development measurement, not a clear-rate gate
limits: one arm (B0), one training seed (0), one fixed step budget (1,000 x 128): no seed variance and no convergence claim
DAgger corpus is 52,500 decisions from 15 β=1.0 shards; 0 verified_dead rows, so the death channel is still uncovered by real data
the seventh seed of batch B (2024) was still collecting and is not included; batch B shards are 2020-2023
S1 is still the 46,397-row train split only, read through the WP03 audit; val/test were never opened
the comparison changes corpus size and collection batch at once, so a frame delta cannot be attributed to data volume alone
20 dev episodes on seeds 1000-1019 only; the confirm split is never read
the model is still trained with the chosen one-hot CE only (no unknown negative, no class weight, no candidate mask)
